title: Warn when resolving an incident from the CLI leaves status page events open
summary: The status page commands in the ask already shipped in rootly-cli#57 (v0.6.1) as `status-pages list` and `status-pages events list/create/update/resolve`. What remains is the footgun in the title: resolving an incident from the CLI says nothing about public status-page entries still open. Add a best-effort, stderr-only warning, in its own helper package, that lists each open event with its status page and the exact `rootly status-pages events resolve <id>` command. No auto-resolve, no renames.
change_kind_reason: Not a bug fix: the incident update works as designed; the ticket asks for visibility into a separate public action.

ask_stands.summary: The requested status-page commands already shipped in rootly-cli#57 under `status-pages events`; only the missing signal when an incident is resolved remains.
ask_stands.remaining: Resolving an incident from the CLI (incidents update --status=resolved, incidents create --status=resolved, alerts resolve --resolve-incidents) still prints no hint that public status-page events remain open.

evidence.quote: Add status page incident event commands

acceptance_criteria.text: After a successful `incidents update` that sets --status to resolved or closed, stderr lists each status-page event for that incident whose status is not resolved/completed, giving its status page ID, its status and the exact `rootly status-pages events resolve <event-id>` command (unit test with a mock HTTP server).
acceptance_criteria.cites: The read check should let a script refuse to report

acceptance_criteria.text: The same warning fires after `incidents create --status=resolved` and after `alerts resolve --resolve-incidents` for each related incident that is resolved or closed (tests).
acceptance_criteria.cites: The read check should let a script refuse to report

acceptance_criteria.text: No warning is printed when the incident has no events, all events are resolved/completed, or the command does not leave the incident resolved (tests).
acceptance_criteria.cites: The read check should let a script refuse to report

acceptance_criteria.text: The check is best-effort: if the events lookup fails, the command still succeeds with the same exit code, and the warning goes to stderr only, so JSON/YAML stdout is unchanged (tests).
acceptance_criteria.cites: Read-only support was called an acceptable fast partial fix

acceptance_criteria.text: The check lives in its own new package (internal/statuspagewarn) and each command calls it with one line; it only warns: no event is auto-resolved, no opt-in flag is added and no existing command or flag is renamed (operator answer: warn only, default behaviour unchanged).
acceptance_criteria.cites: No: warn only, default behaviour unchanged. Resolving a public status page entry is a customer-visible write that can notify subscribers.

acceptance_criteria.text: go test, golangci-lint and go vet pass and total coverage stays at or above COVERAGE_MIN (make coverage && make coverage-check).
The PR is opened and its body links rootly-cli#57 and issue #52 and mentions an opt-in resolve flag as a possible follow-up.
